project.summary: Adults-only DG-LAB Coyote e-stim plugin for DeepSeek Harness: eight safety-bounded coyote_* tools and a DSH-aligned web panel behind one safety envelope.

release.changelog: v0.2.0 adds opt-in event-driven auto-stim on top of the eight coyote_* tools, the DSH-aligned web panel, and the safety envelope. This submission declares the omdsh-workshop-package/v1 dshWorkshop intake manifest.

management.label: dsh-coyote (cordis.patch.yml profile bundle)
management.instructions: Install the npm package through the DeepSeek Harness profile bundle mechanism (dsh plugin add dsh-coyote), then restart the host so the injected web client panel is served. The bundle patch inserts the row automatically with zero required config; tune the safety caps (softLimitA/B, port) in the profile cordis.patch.yml as documented in the repository README.

declarations.permissions: Listens on a configurable WebSocket host/port (default 0.0.0.0:9999) as the DG-LAB V3 socket server that the official App connects to after QR pairing; reads and writes imported community waveforms under the configurable waveformDir. No subprocess, no shell, no native code, no outbound network, no install scripts; adults-only hardware control.
declarations.testing: 148 vitest tests pass at the pinned commit across 17 suites (protocol codec, waveform composer/library/importer/scheduler, runtime safety envelope, auto-stim, GUI bridge, tools, client harness, entry).

capability.invocation: invoke the model-facing coyote_set_strength tool with a channel and an absolute value or a relative delta through the DSH ToolRuntime
capability.expected: a structured result reporting the strength actually applied per channel and any soft/device/rate clamping reason; output never exceeds the safety envelope
